buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Eligibility criteria: 1. OEM/Authorized dealers only to quote. Authorized dealers/Agents of Manufacturer must submit authoriz ation from OEM failing which the offer shall be summarily rejected without any further reference or corres pondence. Dealers must furnish gem product id by OEM verified catalogues only. 2. The bidder or the OEM of the product offered by the bidder shall have supplied the same or similar items for a minimum 20% of bid quantity in a single contract during last three years prior to and excluding bid op ening date to any zonal Railways or PSU or Govt organisation. Documentary evidence i.e., Purchase Order must be furnished along with its R note copy or CRAC (Consignee Receipt and Acceptance certificate) or an y inspection certificate issued by any third party inspection agency i.e., RDSO or RITES or any inspection c ertificate signed by not less than a Gazette Officer. 3. Where the bidder relies upon the past supply performance of its OEM, the qualifying supply shall relate t o the same OEM whose product is being offered in the present bid. The bidder shall clearly identify the OE M and the offered product/model in its bid, and the documentary evidence shall establish that the qualifyin g supply was made by that OEM. 4. Clarification in respect of shortfall information shall be sought only for historical documents that existed prior to the date of tender opening and have remained unchanged thereafter. With regard to documents re quired for meeting the qualification criteria, after submission of the tender, only documents relating to the shortfall already identified in the documents submitted by the bidder shall be considered. No new docume nt establishing a fresh qualification shall be permitted. For example, if a bidder has submitted a Supply Or der but has not submitted the corresponding Completion Certificate/ Performance Certificate, such certific ate may be sought as a shortfall document and considered. However, a new Supply Order, not submitted with the original tender, shall not be sought or considered for the purpose of establishing the bidder's eligi bility or qualification. 5. The specifications incorporated in the additional parameters of the bid shall be reflected in the offered G eM product id, Otherwise the offer shall be rejected. .
